title: Pure Lunalight
summary: Lunalight cards and generic staples, with no second engine. It runs every card the page's Foolish Burial and Gold Leo lines use, so you can play them straight from a test hand. The only outside pieces are the ones those lines need: Tiger King with a single Fire Formation - Tenki, and Constellar Ptolemy M7.

allow.Polymerization: Named by Black Sheep, Kaleido Chick, Scarlet Tiger and Masquerade.
allow.Foolish Burial: One-card starter in the page's lines: sends Yellow Marten to search Masquerade.
allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Set straight from the Deck by Tiger King; searches any Level 4 or lower Lunalight. No other Fire Fist cards.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger Kin: Rank 4 for two Beast-Warriors; its negation spares Beast-Warriors, so it never hits a Lunalight.
allow.Constellar Ptolemy M7: Generic Rank 6 off Lunalight Wolf or Perfume Dancer; the page's Nibiru recovery line uses it.

exclude.Pot of Prosperity: Banishes Extra Deck cards face-down, and Kaleido Chick and Liger Dancer need them there.

main: Lunalight Gold Leo
Starter: on summon, adds another Lunalight monster from the Deck, then discards a card. While on the field, returns a Lunalight sent to the GY to the hand.
Lunalight Kaleido Chick
Sends a Lunalight from the Deck or Extra Deck to the GY and takes its name as Fusion Material. Sent to the GY by an effect: adds Polymerization back.
Lunalight Yellow Marten
Returns a Lunalight you control to the hand to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY. Sent to the GY by an effect: searches a Lunalight Spell/Trap.
Lunalight Silver Hound
Sent to the GY by an effect: Special Summons a Lunalight from the Deck. Banish it with a Lunalight Fusion from the GY to negate a Spell/Trap activated on the field.
Lunalight Black Sheep
Discard it to add Polymerization from the Deck or a Lunalight from the GY. Used as Fusion Material: gets a Lunalight back.
Lunalight Scarlet Tiger

Newest support. Special Summons itself when you activate a Lunalight monster's effect, adding Polymerization if the opponent has activated something that turn. Sent to the GY by an effect: Special Summons a non-Level 5 Lunalight from the GY or face-up Extra Deck, though it can't activate its effects.
Lunalight Emerald Bird
On summon, sends a Lunalight card from the hand to the GY and draws 1. Sent to the GY by an effect: revives a Level 4 or lower Lunalight.
Lunalight Tiger
Pendulum Scale: revives a Lunalight from the GY each turn with its effects negated. Destroyed on the field: revives another.
Lunalight Wolf
Pendulum Scale: Fusion Summons by banishing the materials from the field or GY. The page's lines use it for the second Liger Dancer.
Luna Light Perfume
Revives a Lunalight. From the GY, banish it and discard a card to search any Lunalight monster.
Lunalight Masquerade

Newest support. The turn it's activated, sends a Lunalight monster from the Deck to the GY, which sets off Silver Hound, Yellow Marten and Emerald Bird. On a Lunalight Fusion Summon, gets Polymerization back.
Polymerization
Searched by Black Sheep and Scarlet Tiger, and recycled by Kaleido Chick and Masquerade.
Lunalight Fusion
Fusion Summons from the hand or field; can use a Lunalight from the Deck or Extra Deck if the opponent Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.
Foolish Burial
Sends Yellow Marten to the GY to search Masquerade: the page's one-card starter.
Fire Formation - Tenki
Tiger King Sets it from the Deck; on activation it searches any Level 4 or lower Lunalight.
extra: End boss: unaffected by non-Lunalight cards; sends a Lunalight from the Extra Deck to the GY to destroy the opponent's Special Summoned monsters. The page's lines make two.
Kaleido Chick sends it to the GY and takes its name, which turns Kaleido Chick into Liger Dancer material.
Fusion Summoned: searches Luna Light Perfume. Returns a Lunalight to the hand or Extra Deck, then Special Summons one from the hand.
Going-second finisher: gains ATK for every Beast-Warrior banished or in the GYs, and banishes itself from the GY to give a Fusion Monster 3000 ATK.
Pointing at a Fusion Monster, revives a Level 4 or lower monster from the GY.
Becomes a Link Monster on the opponent's turn that their card effects can't destroy.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King
Sets Fire Formation - Tenki from the Deck; negates every face-up non-Beast-Warrior until the end of the opponent's turn.
Returns a monster on the field or in either GY to the hand.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 that turns monsters to Defense Position and negates the effects they activate.
